sources.entry: EspoCRM - CRM with a frontend designed as a single page application, and a REST API. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: EspoCRM is a free, open-source CRM platform with a single-page frontend and a PHP REST API backend for managing leads, contacts, opportunities, campaigns and support cases.
summary.what_it_does: EspoCRM stores and organizes leads, contacts, sales opportunities, marketing campaigns, support cases and other business records. The frontend is a single-page application, and the backend is a REST API written in PHP. The README says users can create custom entities, fields, relationships and buttons, and that the system can be extended with extensions and custom integrations. Metadata is described with JSON Schema, which the README says gives autocompletion in an IDE. A REST API is provided for integration with other applications. Installation is documented for manual setup, an install script, Docker and Traefik.
use_cases: build custom business applications on a CRM platform
integrate CRM data with other apps via REST API
how_to_run: Check requirements: PHP 8.3-8.5, MySQL 8.0+ or MariaDB 10.6+, or PostgreSQL 15+
Follow the manual installation guide from the documentation
notable: Frontend single-page application with a REST API backend
Custom entities, fields, relationships and buttons without forking the code
Metadata described with JSON Schema for IDE autocompletion
Installation via manual, script, Docker or Traefik options
Community forum and POEditor-based translation project
caveats: Requires a PHP server and one of the supported databases; self-hosting setup is non-trivial
Contributions require accepting a CLA before pull requests can be merged
